source: lab (captured; persons segmented onto a green background, SAM2 watermark bottom-right)
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left of the 1280x720 image) and seconds

camera.motion: static (no background visible; both persons' feet / static body parts stay fixed to <1 px; see notes)
camera.intrinsics_from_benchmark: Orbbec Femto Mega, HFOV 80 deg: f = 0.5959*1280 = 762.8 px, principal point ~ (640, 360)
camera.perspective_cues: no floor/horizon visible (green screen). Standing person feet at y~535-542, crouching person feet at y~600-612 -> crouching person is nearer the camera. Basketball rolls toward the camera (apparent diameter grows ~70 -> ~100 px).

inventory.name: person_crouching
inventory.desc: person in black hoodie, squatting at left (x~60-300, y~386-640); face masked green. Pushes the basketball (right hand, frames ~5-11) and the soccer ball (left hand, frames ~22-29), then the two small balls fly past/in front of their head at the end.

inventory.name: person_standing
inventory.desc: person in blue-grey hoodie and dark trousers, standing at centre-right (x~600-722, y~201-542, ~336 px tall head-top to shoe sole); face masked green. Holds a yellow ball (right hand, image x~700) and a pinkish-grey ball (left hand, image x~628), throws both underhand to the left (release ~22 and ~24).

inventory.name: basketball
inventory.desc: orange-brown basketball, starts at (241,572) under the crouching person's right hand, rolls right/down toward the camera and out of the bottom edge.

inventory.name: soccer_ball
inventory.desc: white soccer ball with black patches, starts at (155,597) under the crouching person's left hand, pushed down-left, exits bottom-left corner.

inventory.name: yellow_ball
inventory.desc: small yellow ball (tennis-ball colour, ~14-17 px across when unblurred mid-flight), thrown by the standing person, bounces (floor not visible) and flies up past the crouching person's head.

inventory.name: pink_ball
inventory.desc: small pinkish/lavender-grey ball (~16-18 px across in flight), thrown just before the yellow one, travels slightly above/ahead of it, bounces, flies up past the crouching person's head.

static_objects: none besides the people (no furniture, floor or markings visible; background replaced by green).
